title: VirtualTour avatar pack v1

format.title: Format
format.description: Pack format and major version. Loaders refuse any other value.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the character. Must not be empty.

sheet.title: Sprite sheet
sheet.description: The image holding every frame and how to cut it up.

src.title: Image source
src.description: URL of the sprite sheet, relative to the URL of the pack JSON.

frameWidth.title: Frame width
frameWidth.description: Width of one frame in CSS pixels.

frameHeight.title: Frame height
frameHeight.description: Height of one frame in CSS pixels.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Number of frame columns in the image. Informational.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Device pixels per CSS pixel in the image. Default 1.

pixelArt.title: Pixel art
pixelArt.description: Render the image with nearest-neighbor scaling.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Named animations, at least one. Each lists its frames in order.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Which animation plays for each role. Roles left out fall back to rest.

rest.title: Rest
rest.description: Animation shown when nothing else plays. Must name an existing animation.

idle.title: Idle
idle.description: Animation or animations played at random while waiting.

greet.title: Greet
greet.description: Animation played on the first step when it has no target; also the fallback when pointing has no animation.

think.title: Think
think.description: Animation played while a step waits for its target.

celebrate.title: Celebrate
celebrate.description: Animation played on the last step when the tour finishes.

exit.title: Exit
exit.description: Animation played when the tour is dismissed.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Animation played when the popover nudges.

point.title: Point
point.description: Animations used to point toward the target, by direction.

left.title: Point left
left.description: Animation for a target to the left.

right.title: Point right
right.description: Animation for a target to the right.

any.title: Point any
any.description: Animation used when no directional one is given.

bubble.title: Bubble hints
bubble.description: Presentation hints for the speech bubble.

dock.title: Dock
dock.description: Default side of the avatar the bubble docks to.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Pixels between the bubble and the avatar.

license.title: License
license.description: License and credit for the artwork.

name.title: License name
name.description: SPDX identifier or name of the license.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: Credit line to show where the license requires one.

frame.title: Frame
frame.description: One frame of an animation, placed on the grid or by pixel offset.

col.title: Column
col.description: Zero-based grid column. Use with row.

row.title: Row
row.description: Zero-based grid row. Use with col.

x.title: X offset
x.description: Pixel offset from the left of the image, divided by the sheet scale. Use with y.

y.title: Y offset
y.description: Pixel offset from the top of the image, divided by the sheet scale. Use with x.

ms.title: Duration
ms.description: How long the frame shows, in milliseconds.

frames.title: Frames
frames.description: The frames in play order, at least one.

still.title: Still frame
still.description: Index of the frame shown under reduced motion and after a non-looping animation ends.

description: A sprite-sheet avatar pack: one image, named frame animations, and the roles a tour presenter plays them for.
